descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role We’re looking for a high-impact Key Account Manager to take ownership of one of our most significant long-term utility partnerships – a major regional water provider serving millions of customers across the East of England This is a commercially critical role where you will own the account strategy end-to-end—driving growth across capital projects (pump packages and related equipment) and aftermarket services, while shaping the future of a well-established, high-value relationship. Your main responsibilities:
• Own the P&L and growth strategy for a utility account, with clear accountability for revenue and margin performance
• Drive the narrative with the customer—positioning us as a trusted, strategic partner across both capital investment and lifecycle services
• Lead and coordinate a multi-disciplinary account team, ensuring alignment across sales, service, engineering and delivery
• Build and deepen senior stakeholder relationships, influencing decision-making at operational and strategic levels
• Develop and execute a long-term account development plan, aligned to the customer’s AMP cycles and investment priorities
• Provide accurate forecasting, pipeline management and reporting
• Act as the voice of the customer internally, ensuring continuous improvement and delivery excellence What We’re Looking For
• Proven experience in a Key Account Management or Strategic Account role within engineering, industrial or utilities environments
• Strong commercial acumen with experience owning revenue targets and driving growth
• Background in pumps, rotating equipment, or fluid handling systems is highly desirable. Alternatively, direct experience working closely with a UK -based water utility provider is a strong advantage
• Demonstrated ability to build and manage high-value, long-term customer relationships
• Experience leading or influencing cross-functional teams without direct line management
• Confident communicator, capable of engaging at both technical and executive levels
• Strategic mindset with the ability to translate customer needs into tangible commercial outcomes What we offer you
• Competitive basic salary
• Car or car allowance – EV options available
• Annual Bonus Scheme
• Private Medical cover
• 33 days annual leave
• Defined contribution pension scheme
• Confidential Employee Assistance Programmes
• Wide range of retail and lifestyle discounts
• Costco membership option
• Discounted personal car leasing
• Long Service Awards
• Continuous learning and development through Sulzer Learning Pathways
• Home working flexibility, with full diary management Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
